header: What interrupted supply last year, and how often
lead: Three hundred and seventy-one interruptions across 3,180 kilometres of line. Storms account for more of them than everything else put together, which is why the renewal programme starts with the overhead sections.
caption: Interruptions on the Larkfield Energy network by cause, 2026
note: Source: Larkfield Energy network report 2026, table 2.3. Planned works announced in advance are counted separately and are not in this table. Figures typed here from the printed report on 31 March 2027.

rows.title: Storm damage
rows.text: 38 % of all interruptions; 104 of them in the February and November storms.

rows.title: Cable faults
rows.text: 30 %; almost all in cable laid before 1975.

rows.title: Third-party excavation
rows.text: 17 %; 41 on sites where no line enquiry had been made.

rows.title: Other and unexplained
rows.text: 5 %; includes four cases where the cause was never established.
